draw_instance_predictions: draw instance-level prediction results with bounding boxes, masks, and labels on a video frame
draw_sem_seg: draw semantic segmentation predictions on a video frame using integer label maps
draw_panoptic_seg_predictions: draw panoptic segmentation predictions combining semantic stuff and instance masks on a video frame
assign_colors_tracking: assign consistent colors to detected instances across video frames using naive IoU-based tracking heuristics
create_detected_instance: create a DetectedInstance object to store label, bbox, mask_rle, color, and ttl for video tracking
